calculation.expression: lag1(residual of cross-sectional OLS [-(close-rolling_min(close,120))/(rolling_max(close,120)-rolling_min(close,120))] on 20-day return)
calculation.description: At each date, calculate a 120-session range-position reversal score and remove its contemporaneous cross-sectional linear exposure to 20-session return. Higher residual scores indicate instruments unusually depressed or elevated within their long range after controlling for medium-term momentum. The signal is lagged one completed session before use.

validation.regime_notes: Passes the benchmark-wide full-sample paper IC and ICIR gates across the 15 tradable cross-asset instruments and many dates. Recent performance is unstable: strong over 120 observations but weak over 260 and negative over 520 observations. Small cross-sectional coverage and possible overlap with existing range-reversal factors warrant conservative weighting and continued revalidation.
